catalogue.name: Residence

description: The residence is a small palace that the king lives in while he visits. As long as there is a Residence in the village, it can never be captured. At level 10 and 20 you unlock an expansion slot, allowing you to train settlers or leaders. With settlers you can found new villages, and with leaders you can conquer other villages.
